title: knautia lancifolia subsp. pocutica
intro: Knautia lancifolia subsp. pocutica, commonly known as Pocutian knautia, is a plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Knautia lancifolia subsp. pocutica include soothing digestive issues, relieving anxiety and stress, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand the plant's chemical composition and its potential applications.
